title: Data-Driven Output Feedback based Analysis and Control for Unknown Discrete-Time Linear System
summary: Using the notion of data informativity, the existing results have given conditions under which the data are informative for controller designs for various control problems of unknown linear discrete-time systems, and have developed methods to compute such controllers from data. Nevertheless, the existing conditions for computing a dynamic output feedback control law based on the input and output data are somehow stringent.
